description: This file defines batch rule implementations for loss functions such as MSE, Huber, and Smooth L1, as well as plumbing functions for binary cross-entropy operations within the PyTorch 'functorch' module. It includes helper functions to handle batching logic, apply reduction methods, and manage batched tensors.
